unit: one shipped UI/HUD image asset decoded from a raw game file (game, original asset path/name, dimensions, alpha, dominant colours, optional 16x8 luminance thumbnail)

kind.instructions: One UI/HUD image asset decoded from a racing game's shipped files. Classify what part of the interface the image itself depicts, judged from its shipped name/path, dimensions, alpha, dominant colours and (where present) luminance thumbnail.

criteria.gauge_dial: Speedometer/tachometer face or arc with ticks, numbers or a dial scale.
criteria.gauge_pin: Bare needle/pin/pointer art used on a gauge.
criteria.gear_or_label: Gear-position or short status-letter plate (R, N, D, 1..6, gear_base).
criteria.input_bar: Pedal/throttle/brake/nitro segmented bar or bar fill.
criteria.map: City/minimap/route map image or route overlay.
criteria.compass: Compass rose, heading ring, north marker or bearing ticks.
criteria.waypoint_arrow: World marker, checkpoint, direction or off-screen arrow.
criteria.progress_meter: Horizontal progress/fill/refuel/rev bar or slider stripe used as a meter.
criteria.banner_message: Full-width message/banner/prompt plate carrying a sentence (PRESS X, GO, RACE FINISHED).
criteria.countdown_go: Start lights, countdown ring or GO badge.
criteria.timer_plate: Timer/clock/lap-time plate, frame or timer bar.
criteria.keycap_prompt: Button glyph, keycap or controller-button prompt (A/B/X/circle/cross).
criteria.wordmark: Game title, manufacturer or screen wordmark/logotype.
criteria.glyphs_font: Font atlas or numeral/letter glyph art.
criteria.icon_pictogram: Small pictogram (tool, trophy, warning, car, flag, wrench...).
criteria.list_row: Menu/list row plate, selection highlight or alternating row tint.
criteria.slider_switch: Slider track, knob or switch control.
criteria.tile_chip: Small stat tile, chip or tab.
criteria.warning_sign: Road/alert sign or warning symbol art.
criteria.notice_block: Informational message box background (green/amber) or notice plate.
criteria.showroom_bg: Garage/showroom/man turntable background or stage art.
criteria.backdrop: Screen scrim, gradient backdrop or background frame tile.
criteria.other_content: Car photo/render, vinyl/livery decal, brand logo or other non-chrome content.

usable_element.instructions: Is this image a complete, self-contained piece of interface chrome that could serve as the raw-game counterpart for a HUD/menu element (not a car photo, decal, mip, shadow, mask-only or fragment too small to identify)?
